ABC denies report of Jimmy Kimmel Live ending in 2027

ABC has responded to a report suggesting that 'Jimmy Kimmel Live' is scheduled to end in 2027. The network denied the report, stating that Kimmel has a contract through 2025. The report originated from an unnamed source cited by a publication. Jimmy Kimmel has hosted the late-night talk show since 2003.
